_about: Starting points only. Prop-firm rules change. Each preset says where its numbers came from and when they were checked; the app shows that and asks you to confirm the values against your own account before treating them as your rules.

presets.label: Custom / other firm (enter your own rules)

topstep_sources.what: Maximum Loss Limit amounts, end-of-day trailing, real-time breach including unrealized P&L, lock at starting balance (Combine) or $0 (Express Funded)
Topstep uses end-of-day trailing drawdown, not intraday trailing
Trading hours: flat by 3:10:00 PM CT, risk team flattens from 3:08 PM CT, trading resumes 5:00 PM CT; trade day runs 5:00 PM CT to 3:10 PM CT
Daily Loss Limit soft breach (flatten, locked until 5:00 PM CT) on the Live Funded Account
TopstepX Personal Daily Loss Limit (fixed or trailing) set by the trader
News trading allowed at your own risk; trades hurt by releases are not reviewed or credited

topstep_notes: Profit targets ($3K/$6K/$9K), the 50% consistency target and the 5/10/15-mini (10:1 micro) position limits were taken from Topstep's Combine parameter pages as summarized by several third-party guides checked on 2026-11-07. Confirm them on your Topstep dashboard.
The Daily Loss Limit is optional at checkout for the Trading Combine and Express Funded Account. It is off in these presets; turn it on and set the amount only if your account has it.
Express Funded Accounts use a Scaling Plan instead of a fixed maximum position size. The plan's tiers are not included; enter your current tier's limit as Max contracts.

Some third-party sources describe a restriction on opening positions around CPI releases. Study Terminal could not confirm this on an official Topstep page, so it is not enforced; the economic calendar still warns you before CPI.
Topstep describes purposefully trading maximum position size into major news as prohibited conduct.
Express Funded payout eligibility (Standard path): 5 winning days of $150 or more, as summarized by third-party guides of Topstep's payout policy. Shown as progress only; confirm on help.topstep.com.
The current Trading Combine parameters list no minimum number of trading days. Set one under Rules if your account has it.

fees._about: Round-turn dollars per contract on TopstepX (NFA + exchange + commission). Exchange fees change; edit these in Settings. Products without a verified number fall back to the commission only and are flagged.
fees.derived_note: RTY and M2K share ES/MES's exchange-fee row in Topstep's earlier fee table; confirm before relying on them.
